prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: The pine intertwinement Once a woman was sitting near a boiling cauldron. The cauldron boiled, she turned the fish, which was standing on the stakes, to the other side. Suddenly she felt a chill on her face. She raised her head up. She looked ahead: a whirlwind was moving at her. She pulled out the knife, put the blade forward, said: "Go around me, if you come close, I will stab." The whirlwind stopped. Spinning again, it passed in the distance.
